Sources: docs/01 (terrain, supply, desertion), docs/02 (prosperity, population, tax, food, development, pillage/occupy), docs/03 (upkeep, units, morale events). Canon CONSTANTS (HERO_IMPACT_MAX, TICK_SECONDS, PILLAGE_*, TAX_SPLIT_LANDLORD_DEFAULT, …) live in code (shared/src/constants.ts per docs/08 §2) and are NOT duplicated here. INVENTED PLACEHOLDERS (not given in docs, flag before tuning around them): supply.drainPer1000Troops (back-derived from 01 §5.3's '1000-troop army holds ~50 min' example), population.basePopCap.WILD/SEA (0), desertion.desertersReturnToWildBanditPct. KNOWN DOC CONFLICT: 01 §5.2 says +5 supply-range hexes per active train, 03 §7 says +3 (chainable up to 3 trains) — using 01's value 5; ❓ OPEN to resolve in docs. ★ RE-SCALED ÷100 (2026-07-10, owner): 1 CT ≈ $0.02–0.10; anchors — line soldier ≈ 0.02 CT (50 = 1 CT), development L1 ≈ 1–1.5 CT, claim 0.5 CT/step; travel/pass/gate fees were already new-scale, untouched.

travel._travelNote: ⚙ Cross-continent = server move (docs/maps/WORLD-MAP-AND-SERVER-TRAVEL.md). Fees modest (1 CT ≈ $0.10): reserve a dock, then move continent. Split owner/occupier/platform-sink; the sink portion follows decision 17 (≥10% burns, rest to vault).
travel._passNote: ⚙ Right-of-way (docs/maps/WORLD-MAP-AND-SERVER-TRAVEL.md §4a). PASS = pay a landowner's toll to cross toward a port (destination-locked safe-conduct, no diverting/attacking). GATE = mandatory intra-continent chokepoint (mountain pass); its holder controls the passage. Policy: OPEN|ALLIES_ONLY|CLOSED. Fees CT, owner-tunable, decision-17 raked.

provisions._note: Battle logistics ⚙ (docs/04 §7c). CT prices per carried unit (ct_units, integer money). defaults* = the standard pack bought at raiseArmy per soldier. battleFoodNeedPer100 = food a battle consumes per 100 soldiers (attacker carries it, defender eats territory foodStock). enduranceFloor = score multiplier at zero food. commandCenterTiers = camp → palisade → fortified camp, requirements scale per 100 attacker soldiers, cost is SPENT win or lose.

claims._: Land claiming (product owner 2026-07-02): adjacent to your holdings = free; farther = CT per step (dispatching a Master). First-ever claim free (founding). ⚙ demo values.

towns._note: Neutral towns ⚙ (Feature Set 2 F2). pct of garrison-free SYSTEM parcels become TOWNs at genesis; population/treasury/prosperity scale with normalized distance from the slice center (frontier towns are richer). walkInMinPopulation: an army ENDING its march on a garrison-free foreign/SYSTEM TOWN — or any SYSTEM parcel at/above this population — takes it WITHOUT battle via the PILLAGE/OCCUPY walk-in choice (ordinary wild hamlets sit below the threshold; set to 1 to make every populated SYSTEM parcel walk-in-able).

developmentEffects._note: Feature Set 2 F4 ⚙ — how development tracks bite in the sim. AGRI production uses food.productionBasePerAgriLevelPerDay, applied per tick with an integer carry. defenseWarScorePerLevel: defender WarScore × (1 + x × DEFENSE level) in battles on the parcel. econCtUnitsPerLevelPerDay: CT trickle (ct_units) to the governor per ECONOMY level (integer carry per governor). milRaiseDiscountPerLevel: training-cost discount per MILITARY level of the raising parcel, capped at milRaiseDiscountMax. Level cap = development.maxLevel.

wildRaids._note: Active wild enemies ⚙ (Feature Set 2 F3). Every everyTicks each monster lair rolls chance = baseChance + edgeChanceBonus × normalized-distance-from-center; on a hit HALF the garrison marches (visible, interceptable) at the weakest player/NPC territory within raidRangeSteps (ungarrisoned preferred; garrisons at/above defendedStrengthThreshold are NEVER picked). Raiders auto-PILLAGE on victory/arrival (never occupy owned land); survivors auto-march home and re-merge into the lair.

economy._note: Circular war economy ⚙ (Feature Set 3, docs/briefs/FEATURESET-3-ECONOMY.md E1/E3/E4/E5). Every wallet→world spend is split by spendCT: LOOT → town/wild-parcel treasuries within lootRadiusSteps of the spend parcel (inverse-distance weighted; no eligible target ⇒ that share burns); LANDYIELD → enrichment pools of the spend parcel (landYieldSelfPct) + its ring-1 neighbors (rest, equal split); LORDS = lordsLandlordShare escrowed in unclaimedLordYield (no NFT landlords yet) + lordsSeatShare to the richest TOWN treasury in radius (none ⇒ burn); BURN destroyed; TREASURY → system:treasury. Integer split, remainder to burn — shares must sum to 1.0. enrichYieldPctPerDay: enrichment pool pays this fraction of itself per day (integer carry) to the parcel's CURRENT governor. enrichLootPct: PILLAGE loots this share of the pool. razeSalvagePct: raze recovers this share of a level's original cost (rest burns). purchaseCapCtPerEpoch: $-purchase faucet cap stub (ct_units, /api/buy-ct is 501 until payments land). lootWindowTicks: rolling window for the /api/economy warzone loot heatmap. journalYieldBatchTicks: per-governor yield REWARDs are batched into the settlement journal every N ticks (anti-spam).

training._note: Training takes time ⚙ (Feature Set 3 E2 — the anti-whale wall). Raising an army pays the FULL cost up-front (through the splitter) but spawns a MUSTERING shell: soldiers materialize at baseRatePerTick × (1 + MIL_level × milRateBonus) per tick (TRAINING sub-phase of PRODUCTION). One active queue per territory. A mustering army cannot march; if attacked it fights with the troops trained so far × musterPenalty. baseRatePerTick 25 ⇒ a STANDARD army (200 soldiers) completes in 8 demo ticks (≈40 s at the 5 s demo tick).

intel._note: Fog of war ⚙ (Feature Set 2 F1). Territory sight radius per contiguous cluster = 1 + floor(sqrt(clusterSize)/2), capped at clusterRadiusCap. Armies see armySight steps; cavalry-majority screens (SCOUTS preset) see scoutSight. Parcels seen by an army stay ACCURATE for decayTicks after last sight, then decay to FUZZY (remembered) forever. FUZZY strengths render as deterministic bands ±fuzzyBandPct, rerolled every fuzzyPeriodTicks ('a day').

battle._note: ⚙ COMMAND-vs-AUTO scaling keystone (docs/04 §3a). LIVE (30 Hz joinable/steerable) battles are a SCARCE OPT-IN resource chosen at MARCH time; AUTO (accelerated headless resolve) is the default. commandSlotsPerPlayer = max concurrent live/queued COMMAND battles one player may hold; liveMatchPoolMax = global cap on concurrent live engine matches (server capacity); commandQueueTimeoutTicks = a COMMAND battle QUEUED past the pool waits this many world ticks before falling back to accelerated. joinWindowSec = pre-combat STAGING window a LIVE match holds open for hero-mode ⚡ late-seating (sent to the match server in the allocate context; EF v2 Moba Server network F5 Fork's dial, default 90s — matches the match server's staging window). Future ⚙ COMMAND FEE (CT sink) phases in on top — not yet built.

duel._note: ⚙ HERO-vs-HERO DUEL (docs/briefs/HERO-DUEL-SPEC.md, decision 14). v2 (owner 2026-07-12): an actual HP FIGHT, not best-of-3 pips. Each Master has STATS from its effective rating (artifact-adjusted): atk = atkBase + eff·atkPerRating; maxHp = hpBase + eff·hpPerRating. They trade blows across up to maxExchanges; the faster (higher-atk) Master strikes first so a KO can pre-empt the counter. A stance CARD each exchange (AGGRESSIVE>TRICK>DEFENSIVE>AGGRESSIVE) swings damage: aggressiveAtk/Def raise output but expose; defensiveAtk/Def turtle; the RPS clash winner gets clashWinAtk, the loser clashLoseAtk. critChance/critMult = a crit blow; signatureProcChance/spellMult = an equipped Named artifact flaring as a SPELL (the wildcard); damageVariance = ± per-blow roll. Ends on KO (or, at maxExchanges, higher HP%). ELEMENT-FREE. It AUTO-RESOLVES (offline handled); an ONLINE player picks a stance each exchange within pickWindowSec, else NPC. artifactRatingBonus = effective-rating multiplier per equipped artifact. flee.baseOdds/caughtPenalty = the FLEE standing-order roll. Deterministic (seeded, replay-safe).

build._note: ⚙ BASE-BUILDING defense layer (docs/briefs/BASE-BUILDING-DEFENSE-LAYER.md, decision 7 / docs/04 §7b 2b). A parcel owner places/upgrades destructible defense MODULES (TOWER/WALL/GATE/TRAP/GRANARY/PET_DEN) onto the map's buildSpot slots; the CF engine seeds the SAME structures onto WILD parcels (in lieu of a player) so there is always something to attack. Cost = baseCostCtUnitsByKey[key] × costGrowthPerTier^(currentTier) — a SINK on the develop cost path (decision 17: ≥10% burns, redistributes around the parcel). maxTier caps upgrades; hpByTier is the per-tier HP the structure persists with (the MOBA engine honors explicit hp/hpMax, and re-derives tower combat stats from the tier). repairCostFractionOfBuild = CT (per tier's build cost) to restore a siege-damaged module to full HP. wild.{towerCount,mobCamps} = how many DEFENDER towers + mob camps the engine seeds on a WILD parcel's slots (deterministic from parcelId); wild.baseTier = the seeded tower tier (zone-strength scaling is a later refinement).

review._note: ⚙ Post-battle 'Recent battles' review (docs/04 §7b). Battles resolve fast (accelerated is the default per §3a) so the player needs a way to review a fight AFTER it ends. ringCap = how many recently-resolved battles the server keeps per world for review (older age out, newest-first, fog-filtered per viewer); reviewTimerSec = seconds each battle shows during 'Review all' auto-advance; timelineKeyframes = compact synthesized strength-progression keyframes stored per accelerated battle (a few hundred bytes, NOT 30 Hz frames — an honest reconstruction, not fake live telemetry); revealDurationTicks = world ticks an AUTO outcome stays SEALED after collision before it may be revealed (sealed-reveal follow-up: the accelerated result is computed at collision but applied/shown only at startTick+revealDurationTicks, so AUTO battles cannot be previewed before normal battle time).

wildBattle._note: Live wild-battle tactical sim ⚙ (docs/04 §7b wild row — prototype). One battle entity = squadSize overworld soldiers. Stats are per battle tick at tickHz. Attacker = waves from the map edge (no CC, StarCraft-campaign style); defender = mob camps + towers, 1 lane. clockTicks = the battle clock (≈ 4 min demo at 4 Hz); unwatched battles advance acceleratedTicksPerWorldTick per world tick — SAME sim, fast-forward (canon: acceleration is the same sim).

command._note: ⚙ Command-mode steering (owner 2026-07-12). Real STANCE effects: DEFEND holds a ring at your spawn (radius defendRadius); FOLLOW = escort the Master (radius followRadius); ALL_IN = hunt anywhere every tick (endgame sweep behavior all fight long). RETREAT speed multiplier (retreatSpeedMult) accelerates the disengage. Standing STRATEGY (offline will): FLEE_IF_LOSING auto-RETREATs once BOTH thresholds trip together — wave stock fraction < stockPctFloor AND fielded-entity fraction < alivePctFloor. Once retreating, the strategy latches this fight (never re-engages). fleeCheckEveryTicks throttles the auto-flee evaluation so a bad frame doesn't oscillate.
